disposition_reason: Slide deck with AAS results (mean, min, max of positives) for Pb and Cd and non-detects for As in pooled pork, liver and kidney.

study.design: Cross-sectional survey of pork value chain residues (antibiotics, beta-agonists, heavy metals)
study.origin: Smallholder pig chains in Hung Yen and Nghe An provinces, Vietnam
study.market: Pork from wet markets; liver and kidney from slaughterhouses; 18 communes in 6 districts
study.method: AAS on 18 pooled samples per tissue
study.lod_text: Pb 70 ug/kg, Cd 10 ug/kg, As 50 ug/kg

findings.group: wet markets, Hung Yen and Nghe An provinces (18 pooled commune samples from 190 pork samples)
findings.locator: slide 'Antibiotic, growth promotor and heavy metal residues in pork', p. 18
findings.notes: 5 of 18 pooled samples positive (p. 16); the slide prints mean (min-max) and appears to summarize positive samples only. LoD 70 ug/kg. Mean sits within 6% of the LoD; Vietnamese MRL for Pb in pork printed as 100 ug/kg.
